title: [GMCP 203.029.05] Interoperability and quality: Local process, filesystem, and network sandboxing
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-029-05. Prove applicable official-suite and reference-SDK interoperability in both roles, direct-versus-gateway differential behavior, property invariants, transport and platform parity, and published latency, throughput, startup, memory, disk, and fairness budgets. Retain regression fixtures for every incompatibility found. Vector outcome: Each local MCP server executes under a declared sandbox profile with minimal filesystem, network, process, device, environment and resource access, implemented on Linux, macOS and Windows with visible degradation when an OS primitive is unavailable. Profiles are generated from permissions, independently enforced outside the child, immutable after launch, and defeated by none of the traversal, symlink, namespace, child-process or localhost escape tests. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
